column1: # The layout: what lives at the top level, in which zone, and what may point where.
# One row per top-level entry. zones:
#   product    what ships; changes with a release
#   evidence   what the gates read and what the results are written into; append-only in spirit
#   materials  external material kept in place (weights, reference repositories, archived literature)
#   notes      half-permanent prose, replaced rather than appended
#   agent      tooling state for the agent that works here
#   scratch    deletable at any moment; tmp is the only scratch area
# may_product_reference: may a file in the product zone mention this path? A product file may point at
# evidence (a result has to be citable) but not at materials, agent state or scratch -- those do not
# exist in a clone, so a reference to them is a broken reference that happens to resolve on this
